name: step-5-preview
description: Step 5 Preview is a flagship foundation model designed for real-world agentic tasks. It delivers frontier-level performance in AI coding, software engineering, and professional knowledge work, with particularly strong capabilities in finance. Built on a sparse MoE architecture, the model has 600B total parameters with 27B activated per token, and supports a 1M-token context window and visual inputs.
zhDescription: Step 5 Preview，一款面向真实世界 Agentic 任务的旗舰基座模型。Step 5 Preview 在 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作等任务上达到前沿水平，并在金融领域展现出尤为突出的能力。Step 5 Preview 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量 600B，每个 Token 激活 27B 参数，支持 1M Token 上下文窗口和视觉输入。
